tips.text: Pick Zenith first if you want one to use; its semi-auto mode has infinite punch-through.
Pick in any order if you only want Mastery; take one weapon at each milestone and every one ends up in your arsenal.
Skip Zenistar if you want one to use; its disc was nerfed to be short-lived.
Treat the Azima as mastery fodder: players who took it do not call it worth the wait.
